account.unresolved: owner: which Cloudflare account hosts disposable deployments

publicOrigin.unresolved: owner: hostname/domain for the disposable origin

oauthOrigins.unresolved: owner: OAuth app registration for the disposable origin

access.unresolved: owner: Access mode (staff-only or all-users) and policy

admins.unresolved: owner: who is ADMINS on the disposable deployment
